Creamy Buldak Loaded Noodles 🍜🧀🥓 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 2 slices mozzarella cheese 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 1 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1 tbsp chili oil, plus extra for topping Buldak sauce, to taste 2–3 tbsp heavy cream Chopped green onions Shredded mozzarella cheese, for topping Toppings Crispy bacon Fried egg Sausage Dumplings Or any toppings you like Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles until half cooked, then drain. In a pan over low heat, add the mozzarella cheese slices and baby Swiss. Let them start to melt. Add ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, and green onions. Mix everything well. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. Top with shredded mozzarella cheese, then cover and let it melt. Finish with crispy bacon, a fried egg, sausage, dumplings, or any toppings you like. Drizzle with more chili oil and top with green onions. Nutella bombolini ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Filling/topping - 7.7 oz Nutella  - Granulated sugar (to cover donuts) Instructions  - In a bowl, combine warm milk and 1 tbsp sugar. Sprinkle yeast over the top, stir lightly, and let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add eggs, 1/3 cup sugar, vanilla extract and mix again until well combined. - Add flour to mixture. Mix until a rough dough forms. - Begin kneading. Once the dough starts to come together, gradually add the softened butter (1 tbsp at a time), kneading until fully incorporated before adding more. - Continue kneading 8–10 minutes by hand or 5–6 minutes in a stand mixer, until smooth, elastic, and slightly tacky. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place onto parchment lined tray cover loosely and let rise 30–40 minutes, until puffy. - In a large skillet heat oil to 325–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry 2–3 minutes per side - Flip every 30–45 seconds for even color - Fry until golden brown - Remove donuts from oil place onto a wire rack  - Toss in sugar until fully coated - Poke a hole in the top of each donut - Pipe in Nutella filling until slightly heavy - Serve & enjoy!  • • • #Recipe #donuts #baking #bakingrecipe
